The Battlefield
// Technology Extraction Reference
LVS: ../external.3ds+
A0: master: FOWLP_TOP

external.3ds+

Dictates material physics parameters (Dk/Df, CTE, Thickness) utilized by multi-physics EDA tools.

3M Digital MATERIAL:

By hardcoding 3M's ultra-low Dk/Df & CTE metrics into the .3ds+, we force EDA simulators to execute "Golden Signoffs" exclusively based on our BOM.

Strategic Context: 3M Material Dominance in 3Dblox
  • 25μm Underfill: Secures TSMC 2.5D/3D-IC micro-bumps. Our material prevents thermal cracking in extremely narrow gaps, guaranteeing Ansys thermodynamic reliability signoffs.
  • 5μm PSPI (Dielectric & RDL): The ultimate signal & stress buffer. 3M's ultra-low Dk/Df properties ensure high-speed signals pass strict Eye Diagram tests at just 5μm thickness without distortion.
  • Cyclotene™ XP-82 (Low-Temp <200°C): A brand new developmental dielectric that preserves the strict thermal budget of advanced 3D-IC fabrication while maintaining high-resolution lithography.
  • Cyclotene™ BF5000 (Wafer Bonding): Solvent-free adhesive enabling flawless 3DIC wafer-to-wafer bonding. It eliminates edge die yield loss during rigorous CMP and crack-free wafer thinning.

By hardcoding these extreme physical limits into the .3ds+ standard, EDA simulators must rely on 3M's material models, establishing an unbreakable DIGITAL MATERIAL.

The Master Lever

3M High-PI: RCX Dielectric Supremacy

Signal Integrity (SI) Dominance: When evaluating 3D Multi-Die integrations, the Eye Diagram dictates the bit-rate limit. 3M's PSPI boasts extreme Low Dk/Df properties, slashing parasitic capacitance directly within the RC parameter extraction models.

Golden Signoff Guarantee: By securing this pure, open Eye Diagram, we ensure that designers running Ansys HFSS will naturally select 3M's material specs as their default RCX baseline.
